title: RETRACTION: Calcitriol Combined With High‐Calcium and High‐Phosphorus Diet Induces Vascular Calcification Model in Chronic Kidney Disease Rats
content:
RETRACTION: Y. Wang, W. Han, Y. Zhong, W. Li, and Q. Liu, “ Calcitriol Combined With High-Calcium and High-Phosphorus Diet Induces Vascular Calcification Model in Chronic Kidney Disease Rats,” Environmental Toxicology 39, no. 3 (2024): 1769 – 1779, https://doi.org/10.1002/tox.24039.

The above article, published online on 8 December 2023, in Wiley Online Library (http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editor-in-Chief, Paul B. Tchounwou; and Wiley Periodicals LLC. Following an investigation by the publisher, the parties have concluded that this article was accepted solely on the basis of a compromised peer review process. Therefore, the article must be retracted.
